author: sabine_loves_me
title: FIX THIS GAME!!!!!!
content:
This could be so much fun, but there are so many UX problems it is frustrating.

You need to fix this game. It needs an overhaul. It could be so much fun, but it’s more frustrating than not.

The matching algorithm is not fair and matches lower ranked players with small winnings with ultra high ranked players with hundreds of billions in winnings, all the time. This discourages players just coming into the game by 1. Ruining their win ratio 2. Making them blow through their coins 3. Losing all the time isn’t fun

Fix the tables! Please make the tables available to players once they earn the rank. A 19th level player should not have access to Paris. Not just if they buy a pool pass or are able to win enough trophies to open the tables. If the algorithm works for matching this will enable that type of “earn by rank” table game. Also don’t reveal them either. The best games you have to win to know where you go next.

Higher level players should have a way to continue to advance. Right now the high level tables are swarmed with bots and so the non-cheating players go back and play in London. Making up in coming players frustrated.

Make a trading marketplace for cues

Allow players to choose cues to favorite so that the ones you use most are there
